requirements.title: Same-file STATUS=OLD preserves SCRATCH deletion status
requirements.definition: For a scratch file reopened with STATUS=OLD as the same file, the file remains considered SCRATCH and is still deleted when the unit is closed.

pending.same-file-open-scratch-status-preserved: Left pending: an unnamed scratch file's later deletion/status cannot be observed portably without asserting processor-dependent scratch names or filesystem exposure.
